slides.headline: Nurses don't struggle because they lack motivation
slides.body: They struggle because they're trying to follow fitness advice that wasn't designed for 12-hour shifts, rotating schedules, and the stress that comes with healthcare.
slides.highlight: That's exactly why this course exists — to give you a system that works with your nursing career, not against it.
